title: BT69012: Plant Biotechnology Laboratory
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Culture initiation; cell suspension culture; micropropagation of herbaceous &
woody plants; comparative study of solid & liquid media for micropropagation;
suitabilities of different matrices for micropropagation; cell suspension
culture in bioreactors; production of a secondary metabolite in culture;
biotransformation by cell line. Extraction and purification of one secondary
metabolite.
